1339-1832-4050-7492.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-4050-7492.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding one mana of any color
When the Insect dies, Arnyn triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Repeat.

997-4694-6258-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
997-4694-6258-7306.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, scrying 1.
Repeat from step 1.

4396-4871-5220-6495.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4396-4871-5220-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.
4396-4871-5220-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1661-4067-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

654-1308-4365-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

4222-6723-7937.description:
Activate Badgey by tapping it, adding {U}.
Badgey triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Badgey.
Repeat.

4681-5170-5231-7918.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

413-5434-5555-7666.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
413-5434-5555-7666.description:
Donate Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 2.
Repeat from step 2.

4720-7420-7546.description:
Cast a copy of Maestro's Gift from exile by paying {3}{U}{R}.
When you cast that spell, Molten-Core Maestro triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and adding an amount of {R} equal to its power.
Maestro's Gift resolves, creating a copy of Inspired Skypainter who enters prepared and with haste.
If needed, activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {R}{R}, adding {U}
Repeat, adding an ever-increasing amount of {R} in step 2.

856-5776-6798-7422.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Garrison Excavator trigger.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

206-240-2511-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat from step 2.

240-3480-5470-6797.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control except Donatello

1251-3259-7291.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control an artifact creature.
1251-3259-7291.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Donatello and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Donatello and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Donatello trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact creature.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the artifact creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase

2921-4605-4681-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {5}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Karmic Guide and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Karmic Guide token enters, it triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1940-4050-5010-7028.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {B}.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Resolve the Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger, causing you to draw Golgari Thug from your library.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {1}.
When the Spirit dies, Liliana, Dreadhorde General triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

123-2921-6972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Highspire Artisan.
When Highspire Artisan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Highspire Artisan enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

862-2173-2921-5220.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1680-4508-4772-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

301-1099-5663.description:
Activate Sling-Gang Lieutenant by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Resolve the Sling-Gang Lieutenant ability.
Repeat.

654-1170-2733-5954-6751.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1353-1768-1947-3327-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1353-1768-1947-3327-4613.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Juniper Order Ranger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and Dargo.
Activate Dargo using Reckless Barbarian's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

2882-3967-6603.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
2882-3967-6603.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a nontoken creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2882-3967-6603.description:
Cause a nontoken creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a copy of Sepulchral Primordial due to Infinite Reflection.
When the creature enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature.
Resolve the creature's trigger, putting a creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control as a copy of Sepulchral Primordial.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-5477-5751-5763.description:
Cast Circle of the Land Druid from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {1}{G} and discarding a land card.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a creature token.
When Circle of the Land Druid enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the creature token and Circle of the Land Druid, adding {1}{G}.
When Circle of the Land Druid dies, its second ability triggers, returning a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

3330-5670-6291.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
3330-5670-6291.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2079-3204-4251-4364.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Aurelia.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Aurelia or Godo must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
2079-3204-4251-4364.description:
Declare either Aurelia or Godo and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Aurelia or Godo trigger.
Resolve the Aurelia or Godo trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Aurelia or Godo from the battlefield, and then returning Aurelia or Godo from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

3139-4050--5.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the persist creature, adding one mana of any color.
The sacrificed creature's persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
The Great Henge triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to draw a card.
The -1/-1 and +1/+1 counters are removed as a state-based action.
Repeat.

428-1077-1694-2719.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces on the battlefield as a copy of Ghyrson Starn.
You have enough mana to cast Wrong Turn.
428-1077-1694-2719.description:
Cast Wrong Turn by paying its mana cost, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 4.

1652-2427-5626.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least {E}{E}{E}.
You have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
1652-2427-5626.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Patron of the Arts and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Patron of the Arts dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Patron of the Arts from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Patron of the Arts enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1061-4305.easyPrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Timestream Navigator.
1061-4305.description:
During your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator.
During your next upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator.
Activate the ability of a Timestream Navigator token that did not enter the battlefield this turn by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it, and putting it on the bottom of your library, taking an extra turn.
Repeat from 2.

56-5256-5355.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Caldaia Guardian triggers, creating two 1/1 Human Citizen creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by tapping the two Human Citizen tokens and exiling five cards from your graveyard.
Repeat.
Once you have milled your library, you may continue the loop by milling opponents instead as allowed, and/or sacrifice the Human Citizens for extra mill.

2034-2459-4381-5224.manaNeeded: {1} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2034-2459-4381-5224.description:
Cast Rograkh either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {0} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Rograkh enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
 Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Rograkh.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Rograkh, adding {C}{C}.
When Rograkh dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Rograkh to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2034-2054-3996.notablePrerequisites: Twilight Drover has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-2054-3996.description:
Activate Twilight Drover by paying {2}{W} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Spirit tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Spirits die, Twilight Drover triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on Twilight Drover.
Activate Urn of Godfire's first ability by paying {2}, adding {W}.
Repeat.

224-1921-2419-4547.notablePrerequisites:
Tawnos does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two artifact tokens.
224-1921-2419-4547.description:
Activate Tawnos' second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it, sacrificing two artifact tokens and exiling Treasure Vault from your graveyard, causing you to create a token of Treasure Vault.
When the Treasure Vault token enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate the Treasure Vault token's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Forsaken Monument triggers, adding {C}.
Activate Tawnos' first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Treasure Vault token and causing you to mill two cards.
Repeat from step 2.

967-1806-2382-2604-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Mimic Vat triggers, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard and returning any previously exiled creatures to their owners' graveyards.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, milling target player for an amount equal to Eternal Scourge's power.
Cast Eternal Scourge for {1}.
Prosper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Eternal Scourge, allowing it to enter the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

643-3638.description:
Cast Turntimber Ranger by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Turntimber Ranger enters the battlefield, creating a 2/2 Wolf creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on Turntimber Ranger.
2/2 Wolf creature token enters the battlefield triggering Turntimber Ranger, creating a 2/2 Wolf creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on Turntimber Ranger.
Repeat from step 2.

1271-3212-3258.description:
Tap Scroll Rack and pay {1} to activate it, putting Beacon of Tomorrows on top of your library.
Pass the turn.
On your next draw step, when you draw Beacon of Tomorrows, reveal it due to Kefnet's ability, making a copy that costs {2} less to cast.
Cast the copy for {4}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn.

631-1785-2178-5010.notablePrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Soldevi Adnate.
631-1785-2178-5010.description:
Activate Soldevi Adnate by tapping it and sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {B}{B}.
Soldevi Adnate, Golgari Thug, and Grim Haruspex trigger.
Resolve the Soldevi Adnate trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Grim Haruspex trigger, drawing Golgari Thug from your library.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.
